Action: Washington said it would ‘significantly upgrade’ the UAE’s export status in recognition of its defence support, including during the war with Iran. The US Department of Commerce said it would give the UAE ‘enhanced favourable treatment’, making it easier to export and transfer US military equipment, satellites, spacecraft, artificial intelligence and energy technology. The measure also removes restrictions on the UAE’s drone programmes. The filing also says the UAE government and approved commercial entities will have licence-free access to advanced computing items, in line with the US-UAE Artificial Intelligence Cooperation framework announced in May 2025
